## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused.
- [ ] Contracts and migrations are compatible or clearly versioned.
- [ ] Tenant authorization was considered.
- [ ] Revision-sensitive work uses an exact commit SHA.
- [ ] Logs and tests contain no secrets.
- [ ] Documentation changed where behavior changed.
